Looking at the figure, there are two curves: a straight line from C to D, and a spiral that begins at B and winds inward to end at A.

Starting at B, I follow the spiral: it sweeps over the top, down the right side (crossing the line C–D), around the bottom, up the left side (crossing the line again), then loops inward over the top of the inner coil (crossing the line once more), and finally terminates at the inner endpoint.

Since I never switch curves at any crossing, I stay on the spiral the entire time, and the spiral's other endpoint is A.

\boxed{A}
